Privacy.title: Privacy
Privacy.description: High-level overview of how Plan2Ponuda handles account, project, billing, upload, and AI processing data.

metadata.title: Privacy - Ploro AI
metadata.description: Privacy overview for account data, billing profiles, uploads, AI processing, Stripe, SMTP, Supabase, and OpenAI.

dataCollected.title: What data is collected
dataCollected.body: The app collects data needed to create accounts, manage projects, process uploads, prepare quotes, enforce usage limits, and support billing.

accountData.title: Account data
accountData.body: Account data may include your email address, name, password hash, session data, settings, company details, and usage history.

billingData.title: Billing profile data
billingData.body: Billing profiles may include billing name, email, address, customer type, company details, tax identifiers, and invoice-related notes needed for Stripe and manual invoice review.

uploads.title: Project uploads
uploads.body: Floor plans and project documentation PDFs are stored in private Supabase Storage. The database stores file paths, metadata, analysis status, and extracted review data.

aiProcessing.title: AI processing
aiProcessing.body: Uploaded plans and project documents may be sent to OpenAI for analysis. AI output is validated and stored so the user can review suggestions before using them.

payments.title: Stripe payments
payments.body: Paid subscriptions are handled by Stripe. Plan2Ponuda stores Stripe identifiers and subscription state, but does not store card details.

email.title: SMTP password reset emails
email.body: Password reset emails are sent through the configured SMTP provider. Reset responses are neutral and do not reveal whether an account exists.

providers.title: Infrastructure providers
providers.body: The app uses Supabase for database and storage, Stripe for payments, SMTP for email, and OpenAI for AI processing. Provider-specific processing must be reviewed before production launch.

rights.title: User rights and contact
rights.body: Users can contact support to ask about account data, billing profile data, uploads, or deletion requests. Final legal rights wording requires review.

Terms.title: Terms
Terms.description: High-level service terms for using Plan2Ponuda during beta and release preparation.

metadata.title: Terms - Ploro AI
metadata.description: Terms overview covering service use, AI review responsibility, subscriptions, misuse, and legal placeholders.

serviceUse.title: Use of service
serviceUse.body: Plan2Ponuda is intended for electricians, contractors, and estimating teams preparing electrical installation quotes.

aiReview.title: AI suggestions require review
aiReview.body: AI-generated rooms, electrical suggestions, document candidates, materials, and prices are drafts and must be reviewed by the user before use.

notEngineering.title: Not final engineering documentation
notEngineering.body: The service does not guarantee that AI output is complete engineering documentation, code compliance advice, or a final installation design.

userResponsibility.title: User responsibility
userResponsibility.body: The user remains responsible for verifying project inputs, quantities, prices, assumptions, legal requirements, and the final quote sent to a client.

subscriptions.title: Subscriptions and cancellation
subscriptions.body: Paid plans are billed through Stripe. Subscription management and cancellation are handled through Stripe Customer Portal where available.

misuse.title: Prohibited misuse
misuse.body: Do not upload unlawful content, attempt to access another user's data, abuse rate limits, reverse engineer protected services, or use the app to produce misleading quotes.

disclaimer.title: Limitation and disclaimer placeholder
disclaimer.body: Final warranty, liability, limitation, refund, and service availability wording must be reviewed by legal counsel before production launch.

governingLaw.title: Governing law placeholder
governingLaw.body: Governing law, jurisdiction, consumer rights, and business customer terms require final legal review.
